pages.text: $(l)Bedrock armor$() is the Chapter 1 armor. It's crafted from rupees (see Finding Ores) and makes you $(l)immune to fire damage$(). It's much better than Netherite armor.

$(l)Magic Protection$() matters just as much. Blazes, ghasts, fireball-shooting mobs and dragon breath all deal $(l)magic damage$(), and they will one-shot you without it. Put Magic Protection on every armor piece if you can.

$(li)Both $(l)Electroblob's Wizardry$() and $(l)Bewitchment$() add a Magic Protection enchant, and you can stack both on one piece.$(li)Spells hit very hard in this pack. Player spell damage is multiplied by 7 and NPC spell damage by 13, which is why a stray fireball can kill you.
$(li)Early on, a good trick is to build into a hill in a plains biome. It's safer than open ground.$(li)Later, $(l)Last Stand$() on your armor helps a lot.
